name: MAC Mobility | Sticky Interface + Sticky MAC Modes
notes: Tests sticky-interface and sticky-mac config on ACs. SC01-SC02: AC<->EVPN (SI-compatible). SC03-SC06: PW interactions (require non-SI mode with active PW data plane).

reference_from_jira.sw_194578: EVPN(ELAN)-VPLS: MAC Move and Sticky MAC Handling
reference_from_jira.sticky_interface: All MACs on that AC become sticky. RT-2 advertised with sticky (Bs>) flag.
reference_from_jira.sticky_mac: Specific MAC on AC becomes sticky via 'sticky-mac <addr>'. RT-2 with sticky flag.
reference_from_jira.sticky_vs_non_sticky_move: Sticky AC ignores non-sticky remote move attempts. Higher seq sticky wins.
reference_from_jira.sticky_vs_pw: Sticky AC ignores PW-learned MAC move. PW->sticky AC: prefer sticky, re-advertise RT-2.

show_commands_validated.show evpn mac-table instance {evpn_name}: SHOW_COMMANDS -- Single MAC lookup with flags
show_commands_validated.show evpn mac-table detail instance {evp: Detailed MAC entries with mobility seq, sticky flag

invalid_commands.show evpn mac-table evi {evi}: DOES NOT EXIST. Use: show evpn mac-table instance {name}
invalid_commands.show interfaces brief: DOES NOT EXIST. Use: show interfaces description

enable_sticky_interface: network-services evpn instance {evpn_name} interface {ac_interface} sticky-interface enabled
disable_sticky_interface: no network-services evpn instance {evpn_name} interface {ac_interface} sticky-interface
remove_sticky_mac: no network-services evpn instance {evpn_name} interface {ac_interface} sticky-mac {test_mac}

scenarios.name: Sticky interface AC: remote EVPN RT-2 cannot override
scenarios.spirent_method: Spirent L2 learns MAC on AC (sticky-interface enabled), then Spirent BGP injects RT-2 with same MAC. DUT must keep local sticky and IGNORE remote.

show_commands: show evpn mac-table instance {evpn_name} mac {test_mac} | no-more
show evpn mac-table detail instance {evpn_name} | no-more

trigger.detail: Non-sticky remote EVPN RT-2 tries to override sticky local

scenarios.name: Both sticky: local sticky AC vs remote sticky EVPN; higher seq wins
scenarios.spirent_method: Local MAC learned on sticky AC (seq=0). Remote sticky RT-2 injected with higher seq. Per RFC 7432, higher seq sticky wins.

trigger.detail: Remote sticky RT-2 with seq=100 vs local sticky seq=0

scenarios.name: Sticky local AC: PW-learned MAC cannot override sticky
scenarios.spirent_role: Spirent L2 learns MAC on sticky AC (protocol-start). Then Spirent sends same MAC via vpls-stream (MPLS PW). Sticky AC should win.

trigger.detail: Send same MAC via MPLS PW (Spirent VPLS peer). DUT should ignore the PW move.

show_commands: show evpn mac-table instance {pw_test_evpn_name} mac {test_mac} | no-more

prerequisites.check_command: show bgp l2vpn vpls summary | no-more

scenarios.name: PW-learned MAC moves to sticky AC: sticky wins, RT-2 re-advertised
scenarios.spirent_role: Spirent sends MAC via vpls-stream (MPLS PW) first. Then MAC learned on sticky AC via protocol-start. Sticky AC wins.

show_commands: show evpn mac-table instance {pw_test_evpn_name} mac {test_mac} | no-more

prerequisites.check_command: show bgp l2vpn vpls summary | no-more

scenarios.name: Sticky-mac (per-MAC config): specific MAC becomes sticky on AC
scenarios.spirent_method: Configure sticky-mac for specific MAC. Spirent learns that MAC on AC. Verify RT-2 has sticky flag. Then remote EVPN RT-2 tries override -- should be ignored.

trigger.detail: Non-sticky remote RT-2 tries to override per-MAC sticky

scenarios.name: Per-MAC sticky on AC vs PW-learned: sticky wins over PW
scenarios.spirent_role: Configure sticky-mac on AC. Spirent sends same MAC via vpls-stream (MPLS PW). Sticky-mac should win over PW.

trigger.detail: PW traffic with same MAC that is configured as sticky-mac on local AC

show_commands: show evpn mac-table instance {pw_test_evpn_name} mac {test_mac} | no-more

prerequisites.check_command: show bgp l2vpn vpls summary | no-more
